items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: Yes. Mostly all the bands I've played with since I've been young at that time, they used to advertise.

ctx.x: No, Mr. Bill, they used to have trucks. And you leave out on a Sunday morning at 11 o'clock, and get in the streets, you might meet two or three bands. And when you get on a corner and meet those bands like that, you couldn't get away. You just had to play. The best man wins.
But did you ever do any of that work before you went with Buddy? With Buddy Petit? Yeah, before you went with Buddy, like with Jules. Did Jules do any of that too, on the trucks?

Yes. Mostly all the bands I've played with since I've been young at that time, they used to advertise. All the dances would be given on a Sunday night like that, they'd advertise Sunday morning. It was wonderful.
